predecessors.name: Ethiopia
predecessors.text: the Tigray Region, a regional state of Ethiopia governed by the TPLF

successors.name: Ethiopia
successors.text: the TDF-held part of Tigray after the loss of Shire in October 2022: Tigray without the Eritrean-held north, without Western Tigray (Amhara-held) and without Shire

ledger.x: 3 November 2020: the Tigrayan forces attack the federal Northern Command and the Tigray War begins.
November 2020: the federal government and its allies fight the Tigrayan forces for the Tigray Region.
28 June 2021: the Tigray Defense Forces retake Mekelle and hold most of Tigray.
17-19 July 2021: the TDF attack into Afar.
August 2021: the TDF take Lalibela and Weldiya.
30-31 October 2021: the TDF take Dessie and Kombolcha.
20 December 2021: the TDF withdraw from Afar and Amhara.
December 2021: Lalibela and Weldiya are no longer held.
6 December 2021: government forces retake Dessie and Kombolcha.
17 October 2022: federal and Eritrean forces take Shire from the TDF.
2 November 2022: the Pretoria cessation of hostilities.
23 March 2023: the Tigray authority becomes the federal Interim Regional Administration.
23 March 2023: the rebel state ends as the Interim Regional Administration of Tigray is formed.

wars.name: Tigray War
wars.outcome: Cessation of hostilities signed 2 November 2022 in Pretoria; the Interim Regional Administration of Tigray formed on 23 March 2023; Western Tigray 'ceded and occupied by neighboring Amhara regional authorities'; Eritrea occupying parts as of 2023.

certainty.note: The front lines of the Tigray War moved month by month; the page gives no boundary for the TDF-held area.
